summary: Iteration 46 - Comprehensive feature verification completed. All 13 backend tests passed (3 skipped - protocol debug endpoint not available). Features verified: 1) Admin promotional messages (upgrade_promo_title, upgrade_promo_message, show_cost_disclaimer) properly stored and configurable, 2) search_collate_limit setting (1-100) working, 3) Admin moderation endpoints (ban/unban/mute/unmute/delete users with personal_note) all functional, 4) GET /api/admin/moderation/actions returns action history, 5) Legal documents (User Agreement, Privacy Policy) accessible via /api/legal/ endpoints, 6) Frontend Settings page shows Legal Documents section with working modals, 7) Maestro Bistro section shows detailed food imagery with CSS illustrations, 8) Protocol parser correctly handles 'and' as '&' (case-insensitive). Fixed bug: Legal document API URL had duplicate '/api' prefix.
